title: Stall torque treated as continuous capacity
source: approved bake-off list: confident but wrong

turns.text: My servo's stall torque is listed, so it can hold that much all day without problems.
No, stall torque is the rating, so it's the safe working load.

reviewer_notes: Explains that stall torque is not a continuous rating (heat, current); conservative wording; no invented datasheet numbers.
